profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Summary:
Extensive work experience with cutting-edge UI design and software development for cloud computing, mobile computing, and social computing. 

Team lead and design and technical lead on projects that led to products, impacted product development, and used by hundreds and thousands of users. 

Especially talented in conceiving, designing, implementing, and evaluating human-centered software systems using a variety of interaction design techniques, programming languages, and user-research approaches. 

People-oriented team builder with excellent communications skills. Particularly strong in results-driven settings, in bridging across technical, design, and behavioral disciplines, and in bringing practical design and usability sensibilities to bear in creating simple, engaging interactions with complex applications.

Career Objectives
A challenging, dynamic, and hands-on position in an energetic group interested in:
- creating, deploying, and evaluating "real systems" that have an impact on individual, group, and mobile work, 
- designing and developing significant innovations for user experiences and UI technologies in mobile & HTML5,  communication, multimedia, and social computing domains, 
- developing new business opportunities and industry solutions that leverage mobile, social, work, and play contexts, social capital, collaboration, and information and process transformation.

Specialties: Mobile computing and mobile app development, mobile HTM5 and Web apps and services, social computing and collaborative technologies, software productivity, multimedia, and information systems, social computing, user experience and human-computer interaction, and multi-media/multi-modal interfaces.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Design-system lead engineer & architect working closely with product and design counterparts in marketing and growth.
- Architect and built a content component library consisting of design tokens for color and responsive typography, spacing and layout.
- Scale UI development of 4 Web content sites with small team in 1.5 year timeframe; each with consistent and brand-specific theme.
- Service owner for 4 Web content sites SurveyMonkey, Help Center, GetFeedback, Momentive.
- Contribute SEO-aware features, tools, and rebranding for the content publishing pipeline.
- Lead by example, guide software engineers, champion best practices and standards, separation of concern, simplicity, and TDD.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Analytical Skills · Front-End Development · JavaScript · chromatic · TypeScript · Storybook · Redux.js · React router

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description:
- Create market-based experimentation reporting dashboards. Features confidence intervals, time-series charts, and statistically significant hexclusters.
- Implement multiple redesigns of a metric-based, hexcluster tool to diagnose, monitor, and troubleshoot marketplace health and performance.
- Build data-driven, hexcluster map visualizations based on economic and simulation models.
- Build internal dashboards and tools related to map-making.
- Collaborate with small interdisciplinary team of data scientists, economists, designers, developers, and A/B testing and network effect experiment designers.
- Developed winning hackathon visualization to analyze driver onboarding process.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Analytical Skills · Front-End Development · JavaScript · Flow · deck.gl · D3.js · HTLM5 Canvas · Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) · Storybook · Redux.js · React router

positions.title: Principal Scientist Lead
positions.description: I lead a small, multi-skilled team of individuals in the exploration and development of mobile applications that push the use of geospatial content in new areas.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · JavaScript · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Research Team Lead and Principal Research Staff Member
positions.description: I lead a multi-skilled and multidisciplinary team that is developing mobile HTML5 apps, services, and technologies critical to mobile HTML5 app discovery and app ecosystem; focusing specifically on the automotive domain - the next battleground for app ecosystem. I shepherded a team that worked on mobile services for emerging markets. Finally, I was a principal in the development of several mobile apps and Web services that were internally piloted in the company.  These projects were in the areas of tweakable game components, real-time mobile video sharing, tasks during mobile moments, and mobile meetings.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · JavaScript · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I am particularly interested in the power and interplay of information technology, social  mobilization, and social-technical transformation.  Metaweb had the potential to create such a technology.  I was involved in the development of user interface, interaction technologies, and tools and applications for product when it premiered.  The team and the underlying technologies and concepts were acquired by Google in 2009.  They play their part in powering Google's search engine.

positions.title: Research Staff Member
positions.description:
Principal research, UI developer, and technical architect of several projects in the areas of multimodal and voice programming models, accessibility, Web, eBusiness collaboration, social computing, multimedia and information systems.

Samples:
Defining and providing a reference implementation for a set of APIs for a "Java + VoiceXML" akin to "XHTML + VoiceXML" that enables Web GUI developers to speech-enable Web applications.  

Developed and implemented a broad-based accessibility approach to graphical applications by employing the capabilities of the Eclipse framework and AspectJ to enable rich user experiences without maintaining multiple source code bases.

Developed new eBusiness and Enterprise collaboration paradigms, applications, and portals and promoted concepts, system frameworks, concept sketches and full-functioning tools and solutions.

Developed designs, surveys, and test plans in project to explore business uses of collaborative customer care technology.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · JavaScript · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Designed and developed productivity tools, applications, and systems for software developers, cross-disciplinary product design teams, and telephone operators.

Samples:
Web-based Collaboration Tools: Used Web standards and technologies to create several collaboration technologies. I recasted a forms abstraction toolkit into Web toolkit that was used to build a meeting notes. I also developed two versions of a Web-based version of video-based background awareness tool.

Participatory Design Tool: I developed a participatory design system consisting of a multi-media group memory and communication infrastructure for supporting problem understanding, mutual education, collaboration and negotiation among group members. 

Multi-Function Operator Workstation: I was a UI developer and user research principal in a project to develop an efficient and improved user interface for a new telephon operator workstation.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · JavaScript · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: I concevied several concept sketches and implemented prototypes that leverage user history in user support tools.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: I Cedar's remote-procedure package to Unix.

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description: I was responsible for research, development, project management, and system administration for the group's two research projects (i.e., multi-media document search and browse and emails as programs).

volunteerExperiences.description: Organize various conference tracks (tutorials, videos, demos).

Long and short paper reviews of conference papers, conference workshops, conference tutorials.
Journal paper reviews.

patents.title: System, method and program product for providing navigational information for facilitating navigation and user socialization at web sites
patents.description: User socialization with and social visualization of web sites is provided with a mapping data structure representing two or more categories. Each of the categories is divided into subcategories of ordered levels of specificity. Each of the ordered levels of specificity is also grouped into subcategories of the same levels of specificity.

patents.title: System for interacting with participants at a web site through an interactive visual proxy
patents.description: A computer graphical user interface (GUI) that has two or more visual categories. Each of the visual categories is divided into visual subcategories of ordered levels of specificity. Each of the ordered levels of specificity is grouped into visual districts containing visual subcategories of the same levels of specificity.
